name: Sakuma Tsukasa
source:
A young teacher at Karin's school who's just returned from overseas. In addition to being a teacher, he has another important job, something that's related to Karin's fate. He's cool, and doesn't say unnecessary things. He seems to know more than he is willing to divulge.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Last_Bullet]Wikipedia[/url]]
